sn22.149:1.11: in consciousness, while meditating observing not-self, they fully understand form, and feeling …
sn22.149:1.15: So, having fully understood form, having fully understood feeling, having fully understood perception, having fully understood choices, having fully understood consciousness, they’re freed from form, freed from feeling, freed from perception, freed from choices, freed from consciousness, freed from rebirth, old age, and death, with sorrow, lamentation, pain, sadness, and distress;
